title: pengchujin/aerial-tv
why_read: A third near-identical Android TV launcher/debloating project aimed at the Chinese market, adding little beyond the other similar tools in this batch.
analysis: This is a tvOS-style launcher targeting Chinese-market Android TVs from Xiaomi, TCL, and others, aiming to remove ads and auto-replace the stock home screen on boot. It serves a similar purpose to other TV-debloating tools appearing in this same digest, suggesting a broader trend of frustration with ad-laden smart TV interfaces. Technically it's a straightforward launcher replacement rather than a novel engineering approach. Most useful to users of Chinese Android TV hardware rather than to engineers generally.
